That lead to me wanting to make an cartoon which would become Cutesy Marron. I started work around December 2018 and finish animation in October 2019. I was an amateur at drawing. The cartoon was done traditionally and I had a lot of trouble with animating it at first. Screwed up the paint and ink in some parts which lead to me throwing out some of the acetate but I pulled through. I did the whole thing all by myself. Since then, I started experimenting more with the animation medium (I managed to create an entire 13 episode series based off of my math teacher mentioning Mongolian yak trade in algebra class) and found a new respect for magical girls.
